vb_textbox.text: There are two different colour groups that work together to give you the highest points. Red & Purple are group 1. Green & Brown are group 2. Pick any colour Gnome to begin with and once you score 3 points or more, keep to picking the colour Grones in that colour group. Always pay attention to which colour group of Gnomes you are selecting. Switch to the other colour group if the score is below 3 and continue in that new colour group when you continue picking the Gnomes on the continuous rounds as you will gain the most points. Only switch between the colours but as often as necessary during the game keeping 3+ in mind. Pay attention and enjoy!
